overall_notes: The paper focuses on creating and evaluating a cultural instruction dataset (CultureInstruct). NLG tasks are used for data creation but evaluation focuses on cultural knowledge benchmarks rather than traditional NLG quality metrics. Human evaluation was conducted on instruction quality (234 samples with 5 annotators) to validate the LLM-as-judge approach. The paper uses LLM-as-judge to evaluate instruction quality and cultural relevance, with human evaluation serving as validation.
